DECISION
DECISION: Pixel Office stale session cleanup is handled exclusively by session-end hook firing, with a very long fallback (5+ min) only as last resort.
OPTIONS:
- Time-based (60s): tried first, removed active sessions during long pauses between tool calls (e.g. user typing a message)
- Time-based (5min): still wrong in principle — session could be idle legitimately
- SessionEnd-only: hooks fire when Claude Code exits, so cleanup is accurate
REASONING: Claude Code sends a session-end hook when it terminates cleanly. The only case where cleanup doesn't happen is if the terminal crashes. For that edge case, a manual cleanup or very long (5-10 min) fallback is acceptable.
REVISIT WHEN: Users report ghost workers after terminal crashes lasting too long.
